Cytokine family, historically thought to be produced by leukocytes; members are numbered.

Negative regulator of JAK-STAT signaling; competes with STAT for JAK binding.
Software using hidden Markov models to annotate receptor sequences to the germline.

Lymphocyte whose receptor recognizes peptide on MHC; includes helper, killer and regulatory types.
